items.t: GE Vernova Is 35% Below Its High After Raising Its Year-End Gas Turbine Goal to 130 Gigawatts
items.sum: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova stock is 35% below its high, even though the company raised its year-end gas turbine goal to at least 130 gigawatts from at least 125. Analysts kept raising earnings estimates through the selloff, so the market is pricing in a peak in turbine demand that the contracts don’t show yet.
